statement: Major patch drops in 2 days; there is time-sensitive content this week to prepare for before Friday.
Divinity week is back and next patch requires Divinity pushed, specifically Coral keys (world 7 mechanic) and God ranks progressed.
Need at minimum around God rank 20 for some of the new content in the next patch.
Get characters pre-stacking on Divinity this week.
Preferably lab stack Divinity as well if you have the Goat God linked or are a dude owner.
Use the Mindful stance or the next highest stance for maximum Divinity point gain.
At a 61% vote share it is almost certainly a Divinity sweep this week.
Meritocracy has stamina week again for spelunking.
Newcomers to spelunking shouldn't do anything special for stamina week.
Veterans should stack the biggest overstim possible and use it on the last cavern or scout post for biggest amber run.
The biggest amber run feeds into daily amber gains until the next stamina week.
Stamina week is a good time to spend runs on grand discoveries; easy now with multiplicative find chance sources including new Royal Guardian talent.
Just an okay week on the exotic market but some nice crops are on offer.
Legumes two is the top pick: a direct multi to beans.
Extra beans are critical to night market progression which is critical for long and short-term farming progression.
Legumiosso three is second pick; back second week in a row; best of the legumiosso bunch with big additive bonus to beans.
Vigaroot one is a multi to land rank EXP and third pick.
Land rank EXP is very important for progression across the board in farming.
Stable root two is fourth pick for same reason (land rank/beans) except it is additive.
None of the top crops return until 2027 so invest while available in the order mentioned.
Purple grass gives tachyons which is a good stat but a very poor source of it.
Grapevine is a multi for villager EXP which is great but we are not starving for it.
Farmer brain is additive farming EXP which is just okay at best.
Poison hemlock is last: kill per kill is amazing but additive and tiny source in a terrible bucket; bait.
Pirate Glembo is the only real pack this week and a decent value at $17.
Only reason to buy the pack is the Glembo pet itself; if you can get it otherwise do that.
Glembo offers extra kill multi for pushing and G mush and artifact find chance; new artifacts coming soon so pays off quickly.
Weekly boss this week is Unit T31.
Miscellaneous runs net 11 trophies and 30% class XP and 15% bonus damage.
Best trophy week for daily runs for the foreseeable future through to April next year; take weekly bosses seriously and do daily runs.
It briefly intersects ribbon week which is the best time to pop golden stopwatches; do it now if you have time.
Extra weekly boss damage comes from divinity week and laboratory level.
Extra weekly boss damage also from digits of ram kills in world three; explained in a recent daily video.
Nothing crazy in the lab shop this week or near future.
Galvanic nanochip is a mainstay in many chip stacks and a fantastic filler chip in worst case.
Grounded processor is basically worthless.
Emerald pyromite in the jewel spinner gives a healthy cooking speed bonus and is well worth grinding for if you lack it.
New Friday patch has end-game related content and challenges; check patch preview video to prep.
Pillar pages are still bugged.
